cash.voidBody: A reversing journal will be posted. Reconciled documents cannot be voided.

bank.title: Cash & bank accounts
bank.glHint: One cash/bank ledger account per bank account.

txn.inHint: Receipts outside receivables: interest, capital injections, other income.
txn.outHint: Spending outside payables: operating costs, advances, petty cash. Large amounts need approval.

transfer.feeHint: Charged to the source account and booked as a bank fee.
transfer.hint: Move money between your own accounts. Across currencies the FX difference is booked automatically.

reconcile.title: Bank reconciliation
reconcile.newHint: Copy from the bank statement: period plus opening and closing balance per bank.
reconcile.deleteBody: The reconciliation and all its statement lines will be deleted.
reconcile.csvHint: Columns: date, description, reference, amount (or debit/credit). Delimiter ; or ,
reconcile.noLinesHint: Import a CSV from internet banking or add lines by hand.
reconcile.amountMismatch: The statement line and book entry must have the same amount.
reconcile.bookHint: The {amount} line of {date} is posted as a cash transaction and matched right away.
reconcile.finishBody: Every line must be matched and the computed closing must equal the balance per bank.
reconcile.csvInvalid: Unrecognised CSV. It needs a date column and an amount (or debit/credit) column.
reconcile.csvNoRows: No readable rows in this file.

vat.title: VAT per period
vat.voidBody: A reversing journal is posted and the VAT balances go back to the output/input accounts.
vat.settleBody: Output and input VAT balances move to VAT payable or VAT overpaid in one journal.

wht.title: Withholding tax
wht.withheld_by_usHint: Tax we withheld from supplier payments; deposit and report per type.
wht.withheld_from_usHint: Tax customers withheld from us; collect their slips to claim the credit.

codes.whtTypeHint: Required for withholding, empty for VAT.
codes.dppHint: 11/12 = 0.9166666667 for 12% VAT on the other-value base
codes.salesHint: VAT: output VAT. Withholding: prepaid tax (withheld by customers).
codes.purchaseHint: VAT: input VAT. Withholding: tax payable (withheld from suppliers).
